steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Long time no see, Rosalie.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Rosalie!

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: —Ah, darling Rita.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: It's been an awful while since we last got to chat, hasn't it? Such a shame we couldn't be in the same accommodation like we were before.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Really, Royal Guard runs far more arduous militarization drills than either of us could've imagined, wouldn't you say?

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Did you make it to the entrance exams on the day?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... What has you asking that? Of course I made it—I wouldn't be here otherwise.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: No, nothing... Here, your Introduction to Military Science. The notes you left in there were very helpful, much appreciated.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: I was going to give it back the morning of the exam, but I left before I saw you. It's been sitting in the back of my mind.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Want to get dinner together? We can catch up on the way. You can pick a dress for me to wear on my off day.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Sadly not. I'm on my way to that ball Stefanie's hosting.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: You mean that Leithanian count's daughter?

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: I hear she's quite rich with contacts. Merchants wanting an inroad or musicians and playwrights in need of a referral can't go wrong in her social circle.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: The last time I ran across you, you were going to that army staff officer's granddaughter's soirée. Military families like that are always on the lookout for a few trustworthy aides to groom.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Not that that should've had anything to do with your goals. You used to hate these noisy social events.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Don't say that, Rita. Can't I just enjoy a little dance?

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: We'll chat the next time you're free, then.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Don't look so crestfallen.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: We need a little time to find our own rhythm in new environments, that's all, no?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: (Humming) Like the steps of a dance. Oh, what tough luck—I was so badly hoping you'd accompany me.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Rosalie, do you remember why we worked so hard to get into the Royal Guard Academy?

spans.text: we worked so hard to get into the Royal Guard Academy?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Well, there's a silly question. To become outstanding servicemen, of course.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: Right. Not officers, not military aristocracy. Servicemen. I don't want to be the Skamandros whose own safety supersedes all, like my father.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: And you want to be the kind of serviceman who can staunchly uphold order, as our tutor did.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: What I'm saying is... if you're worried about anything, you can talk to me.

steps.name: Rita
steps.text: I don't think we've visited our tutor's grave yet, not since she passed on.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Ah... Terribly, awfully sorry, but I'd better be going, Rita.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: So say the papers. The 'Londinium-Kazdel Association of Economic and Cultural Exchange.'

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Some duke, God knows who, threw masses of Sarkaz mercs into Londinium. Their own pieces in the game, so to speak.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Well, I quite disagree.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Oi, keep schtum. If you know inside details, then I'm the last person who wants to hear.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Oh, my. The duke most likely to control Victoria? The aristocracy's rumors of where the Lion King's heir has ended up? The cities that might be expecting riots soon...? Not even one bit curious?

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: What good does knowing that stuff do for me? I don't even want to know which City Hall member's family tutor you are.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Were, I mean. Your tutor thing's probably past tense now.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: So it is. I just wrapped up the final course yesterday.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: The young master has a grasp of plenty enough knowledge by now. He won't be needing me anymore.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Haha... and I assume you have plenty enough intelligence from snooping around there.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Enough for my boss to take this assignment on himself, and add a few more decorations to his wall of honor, you mean?

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Ahem, *cough* *cough*... I'm not going to talk about anyone behind their backs.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: *sigh* You ought to keep a few measures in place, to avoid anyone stealing your credit.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Well, these things do happen. What's the use in minding it?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Enough, now. I'll take a fashion magazine.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Coming up.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: From now on, anyone who's got a special coin like yours, no matter who, gets to buy this magazine, right? Just checking.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Don't worry, I've done all the liaison work. You won't possibly mess this up.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Besides, you know nothing of the situation. Even if someone comes knocking on your shutter, it's not like they can do anything to you.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: There'll be no waves in your peaceful life, and all that's coming will be the pay we promised you.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Heheh, guess you've read me to boot.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Thank God for this income. I can send my kids to a better school, and they can become proper gentlemen.

steps.name: Newsagent
steps.text: Oh, yeah, how long'd it take for you to cover up that serviceman's valor of yours? I can tell all the officers I know even out of uniform, but not you.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Serviceman?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: I am part of the military, yes, but I never once said I was ever a serviceman.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Well, toodle-oo, I have an invitation to a dinner party. I'd better be on my way.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: No matter if a city plate collapses one day, or the blood forms a river through the Palace of Westhaleg, I'll be out of it, carrying on with my life the same as it ever was.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: I've seen enough of all these clever-clogs exuding their dignity.

spans.text: of all these clever-clogs exuding their dignity.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Right, then, let's have a look... What news has my fine informant brought me?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Here's a letter...

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: ...that's been changed out already? They've stuck a note inside.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: '...I know your identity, but I am not an enemy of Victoria.'

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Dearie, now, that single sentence certainly isn't going to show if your interest is in aiding me, or kidnapping me.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Everyone loves to say they do it 'for Victoria.'

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Whether you were hanging the Lion King or bracing the royal family together, you thought were defending Victoria all the same.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: If everyone's efforts were aligned, we wouldn't be in need of intel-sniffers like yours truly.

spans.text: If everyone's efforts were aligned, we wouldn't
in need of intel-sniffers like yours truly.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Perhaps I'll need to pass a message on at the party tonight. Have this mysterious figure's intentions cleared up once and for all.

steps.name: Curious Noble
steps.text: Have you heard? Two of City Hall's holdouts are finally caving in. They're restoring a fleet of steam tanks, and issuing a decree to relax the restrictions on factory owners.

steps.name: Pompous Merchant
steps.text: Hahah! At least the money we've been spending on them hasn't gone to waste.

steps.name: Pompous Merchant
steps.text: The older they get, the more reluctant they are to take a stand. It's all normal fare to give the army more weapons, they're just scared people will ask: Whose army is this? Who are they fighting?

steps.name: Pompous Merchant
steps.text: Ever since we lost the Lion King, they've been harder and harder questions to answer.

steps.name: Curious Noble
steps.text: Oh, pooh to that. Do you remember that doddling Assembly Member, the one sickness took in her own bed last month?

steps.name: Curious Noble
steps.text: Her neighbor told me, everyone was hearing horrible screams muffled through the walls that night. Would you say illness wasn't the true culprit? I wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Pompous Merchant
steps.text: That's what the old guard get for not wanting to relinquish their powers.

steps.name: Pompous Merchant
steps.text: Come, let's poke our heads into the ballroom. Allow me to fetch you a glass of wine.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Conspiracies, bribes, assassinations... oh, there's nothing new under the sun.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: It's about time I dropped by the balcony. I should have good company to meet there.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Good evening, Miss Harmonie.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Dearie me...

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Do you have a moment?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Not particularly, no. If you aren't careful enough with what you say, my Arts will make waterworks in your windpipe and seize you by the throat.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: You react very fast.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: I do like your complexion. Your breathing isn't coming at a rush, either.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: You're misunderstanding me. That note I snuck into your intelligence network wasn't meant to intimidate you at all.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Then carry on. What exactly is it you want from me?

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: A marquess sent me to convey goodwill.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: If you're of a mind to assist with our work, you should at least have some valid intel on you, no?

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: No. I'd like to offer you a new destination.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: You were coerced into becoming intelligence personnel, serving the shambling rot of the Lion King's army. It does disservice to your talents.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: You shouldn't let yourself be tormented by a little years-old blunder either, and that's not to mention how you were completely in the dark at the time. It simply isn't your fault.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: They did me plenty of favors in order to cover that scandal up.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Don't you think you know a little too much?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Miss, I'm baaack. Your letter's been delivered.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Tomorrow being the entrance exams and all, I'd like to consult you on a few more questions I have. Mainly about how they test Originium Arts...

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: ...Is nobody in?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Miss? Are you alright?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Familiar knocking sound, most likely the kind of saber Miss uses... *gasp* What if somebody's robbing her?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: A seasoned serviceman like her should have all the ease in the world ridding herself of a few bandits. Although, this is the perfect chance to test my own abilities a little.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: The smugglers are all down! Enter the warehouse and sweep!

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Miss... Miss Horley?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: There's still an accomplice in here!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: Weapons down! Hands up!

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Who are you lot?

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: Got the full situation out of her?

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: We've finished questioning. She's a student of Horley's. Still quite young. She didn't know a single thing about this gang reselling military goods.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: She has acted as their middleman on multiple occasions by delivering Horley's letters, but she hadn't a clue what she was passing on, nor did she ever have suspicions about her teacher.

spans.text: acted as their middleman on multiple occasions by delivering Horley's letters, but she hadn't a clue what she was passing on, nor did she ever have suspicions about her teacher.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: Horley took up a teaching post at a noble's private secondary school after being discharged. No criminal record for the past five years, very esteemed by her students.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: As far as the one here recalls, Horley never showed signs of involving any students as her accomplices. We can likely go without inspecting the rest of the student body.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: We've been holding her for two days. I know it's only been a normal interrogation, no deliberate pressure, but judging by what details we've observed, she's 100% honest.

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: Alright, let her in. We'll run this as planned.

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: Do you now understand the full course of the incident?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: My tutor committed a serious crime, and I was an accessory to it under unwitting circumstances... That's more or less what I've gathered.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: If you don't mind my asking, how has Miss...?

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: She refused to cooperate, going so far as to incite a violent clash with the military. The only option she gave us was death.

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: As for the resale of military goods, we've been on that trail for over a year. Horley took advantage of her military connections to serve as a key figure in the resale chain. That cannot be denied.

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: We would desire for you not to sympathize too greatly with her.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: Was she a good teacher?

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: She was a firm, strong fighter. I very much admire the strength she displayed.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: The things I learned from her were worth more, I think, than what I ever picked up in my etiquette class or social speaking drills.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: The idea she'd been doing this, and then failed, and fell, in this manner...

spans.text: , and then failed, and fell, in this manner...

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: ...It's somewhat beyond what I would've expected. That's all.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: I respected her. Nothing more than that.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: We express our acknowledgement of the shock this incident has been to you.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: Please be assured, we won't be investigating your conduct, nor will we regard you as her accomplice.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: However, we desire for you to be the sole civilian who knows of this. You must maintain silence on the facts of this incident.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: Horley, along with two other soldiers who participated in the resale, will be recorded as assistant military to this operation.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: Remember: they 'bravely gave their lives in the fight.' That is what you should say to your classmates, your professors or anyone else, once news of her death reaches your campus.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: In addition, they'll be posthumously awarded. We hope you'll understand that we've put much thought into upholding the reputation of the woman you respect after her death, which we desire to grant her some dignity in.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Mm, I understand the matters on which I should be silent.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: We're very glad we could reach a consensus. There'll be some favors done for you.

steps.name: Rosalie
steps.text: Favors?

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: Your account was, you visited her to prepare for the Royal Guard Academy entrance exams.

steps.name: Gentle Officer
steps.text: You'd like to get into Royal Guard, correct?

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: I'm just one of the military insiders from back then, by coincidence.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: If you came here to reminisce with me, then you really are courteous to a fault.

spans.text: If you came here to reminisce with me, then you really are courteous to a

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: After all, that was however many years ago. Even I don't remember it all off the top of my head anymore.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: I sympathize with what you went through years ago—that's exactly it. I can't bear to see a youngster with such limitless prospects not get the credit she deserves.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: I imagine you've noticed, somewhere in there, that your life fell out of your control ever since that affair.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Despite getting into Royal Guard, you were forced to change identities and go fully incognito without ever graduating, and when it comes to intelligence work, forging genuine interpersonal relationships is a tall order.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Fortunately, you could consider yourself lucky all the same. The Marquess seems to take a very vested interest in your abilities. You can get in touch with him via my referral. Perhaps you could even strive to become a personal aide.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: You can free yourself from your identity as an intelligence agent, and obtain a higher status doing it.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Is phrasing it that way able to win your confidence?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Yes... that's all it is, no more.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Could you elaborate?

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Don't you mind, that was just a little private monologue.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: My opinion is, if we carry on like this, my staff and the skin of your throat may just threaten to close their own distance.
But upon those words, Harmonie stows her staff away.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: —You're invited to leave now.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Madam, if you're declining because the difficulty of disengaging from your intel work worries you, then please trust that we have methods sufficient to aid you.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: It seems you think I'm dictated to hate my life and my lot in it.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: You've made a—not uncommon misunderstanding, I'll say. Conspiracies bury themselves all throughout life. So many little incidents are secretly the grand designs of master architects like yourself, am I wrong?

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: You'll have seen that sort of thing a great deal, as an intelligence worker.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Quite. I've gotten fairly sick of seeing it, and even fairly sick of doing it.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: The fact of the matter is, nobody forced me into intelligence work. Some professors selected me, I agreed, and that was that.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Do you know something? If I really, truly hadn't the power to control my own life, I'd be compelled to kill you here and now, so as to avoid you bringing any hassle to my door.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: But I very much take a liking to you.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Now, we were here to take part in a dinner, weren't we?
Harmonie turns away with light grace.
Inside the hall, the ensemble bows and readies to begin performing. The bright fixtures shine through the floor to ceiling windows, outlining her in a glowing silhouette.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: (Humming)
With carefreeness, she lifts her arms, and spins a full circle.
There in the courtyard, she dances on her own in brisk, spry steps.

steps.name: Kind-Faced Noble
steps.text: Who... will you be having your dance with?
The Feline named Harmonie gives no answer.
